counts_note: creatures = creature behaviour kinds (schema only; the box has 0 creature rows); classes = class IDs in include/game/character.hpp (11 race IDs also listed, category-level only); weapons = ranged sub-types in weapon_type.hpp; gear_sets = 0 because the item set catalogue (wowee_item_sets.hpp) is schema only and no set rows are in the box; zones = ambient zone types in ambient_sound_manager.hpp.
creature_families: Behaviour kinds (6): Melee, Caster, Tank, Healer, Pet, Beast (include/pipeline/wowee_creature_behavior.hpp lines 61-68).
Evade policies (4): reset to spawn, heal along the path, flee but stay attackable, no evade for bosses only (lines 70-79).
Family kinds (6): beast, demon, undead, elemental, not-pet, exotic; with a pet talent tree and a minimum level to tame (include/pipeline/wowee_creature_families.hpp lines 48-84).
Spawn group kinds (6): boss, mini-boss, rare elite, trash, add, world boss (include/pipeline/wowee_creature_difficulties.hpp line 53).
Creature rows: none in the box. The behaviour and template formats are schema only.

top_creatures.label: Permanent-leash boss
top_creatures.why: A boss that never resets is a rule a player learns in one fight.
top_creatures.keep: The no-evade policy for bosses only.
top_creatures.change: Our leash and hate list (parity row 4); a visible warning before the leash snaps.

top_creatures.label: Flee-but-stay-targetable
top_creatures.why: A creature retreats home but can still be hit on the way, so chasing stays a choice.
top_creatures.change: Our retreat speed and an exhaust pose.

top_creatures.label: Heal-on-the-way-home
top_creatures.why: A creature that regenerates while it walks back makes a pull-and-reset loop readable.
top_creatures.change: The regen rate and where it stops.

top_creatures.label: Ability roll with cooldown in basis points
top_creatures.why: Each special ability has a cooldown and a use chance written in basis points (0 to 10000), so the roll is exact.
top_creatures.change: Our numbers and our ability names.

top_creatures.label: Group-size variant boss
top_creatures.why: A base creature maps to a stronger variant when a bigger group engages (normal-10, normal-25 and heroic variants).
top_creatures.change: Map it to our MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 and our own tiers.

top_creatures.label: Taming gate by family
top_creatures.why: Each family has a minimum level before it can be tamed, and a pet talent tree.
top_creatures.keep: Family kind plus a minimum level gate.
top_creatures.change: Our summons and our gates; no pets from the donor.

top_creatures.label: Rare elite roaming spawn
top_creatures.why: A rare elite is a separate spawn kind from trash, so it can appear in a zone without being a boss.
top_creatures.change: Our spawn caps and respawn (parity row 23).

top_creatures.label: Open-world boss with no variants
top_creatures.why: An open-world boss has no difficulty variants, so it is one fixed rule for everyone.
top_creatures.keep: One fixed rule for open-world bosses.

classes.label: Class IDs (10)
classes.role: Not in the box (game data); role grouping not checked against the enum.
classes.progression: Not in the box; trainer and talent formats (WTRN, WTAL) listed in the editor format table.

weapon_families: Ranged sub-types (5 plus none): bow, gun, crossbow, thrown, wand. A wand gets its own pose even though it shares the ranged inventory slot (include/rendering/animation/weapon_type.hpp lines 9-12).

Melee pose flags: two-hand loose (polearm or staff, line 25), fist, dagger, off-hand, shield (lines 24-35). The header describes a fixed bug where the off-hand swing borrowed the other hand's pose (lines 30-33).
gear_tiers: Item quality: 8 tiers from poor to heirloom (include/game/inventory.hpp lines 11-19).

Item material kinds: 12 (cloth to ethereal and hide), 3 weight categories, 6 flags (include/pipeline/wowee_item_materials.hpp lines 46-73). The magical flag comment says it glows (line 69); no runtime reader found.
Item sets (schema): up to 8 pieces, up to 4 bonus thresholds, the standard 2/4/6/8 pattern (include/pipeline/wowee_item_sets.hpp lines 19-21, 76). No set rows in the box; no runtime reader found.
Gems: 8 colours with secondary colours as mixes and a prismatic wildcard (include/pipeline/wowee_gems.hpp lines 53-61). Loader only.
zones: Ambient zone types (8 plus none): forest normal, forest snow, beach, grasslands, jungle, marsh, desert canyon, desert plains (include/audio/ambient_sound_manager.hpp lines 34-44).
Precipitation weather (6 plus none): rain and snow, each light, medium and heavy (ambient_sound_manager.hpp line 29).
Zone lookup: tile to zone (include/game/zone_manager.hpp line 62, tileToZone), area to zone (line 36), outdoor PvP flag (line 46).
Dungeon archetypes: none in the box (instance data is the user's files).

looks.label: Charge ribbon
looks.technique: A vertical ribbon whose colour blends base to top by height, with a heat tint and an alpha that fades from the base.

looks.label: Lens-flare glow
looks.technique: A Gaussian glow multiplied by an edge fade; the file comment says the fade stops a bright square at the quad edge.

looks.label: Charge dust disc
looks.technique: A point-sprite disc that discards pixels past its radius and fades alpha to a low value.

looks.label: Lightning bolt
looks.technique: One brightness value drives both colour mix and alpha.

looks.label: Lightning flash
looks.technique: One push-constant intensity sets a white flash.

looks.label: Combat camera presets
looks.technique: Three presets: default (75 degree field of view, 12 m back, damping 10), wide ranged (90 degrees, 18 m, damping 15), tight melee shoulder (60 degrees, 5 m, 1 m shoulder offset, damping 8, tracks the chest).

originals.name: Leash Keeper boss
originals.idea: Four named leash-return policies per creature as data: reset home, heal along the path, flee but stay attackable, no leash for bosses only.
originals.change: Our leash and hate list; our names; no donor code.

originals.name: Ability Dice
originals.idea: Each special ability has a cooldown and a use chance in basis points.

originals.name: Party-Size Variant Gate
originals.idea: A base creature maps to a stronger variant when three attackers engage.
originals.change: Our tiers and our naming (no normal-25 or heroic labels).

originals.name: Combat Camera Trio
originals.idea: Three fight-camera presets (default, wide for many-vs-one, tight for a duel) with damping per purpose.
originals.keep: Per-playstyle field of view and damping.
originals.change: Our numbers and our shoulder offset.

originals.name: Heat Ribbon Dash
originals.idea: A dash trail whose gradient and fade follow height.

originals.name: Soft Glow Sparkle
originals.idea: A Gaussian glow with an edge fade for hit flashes and auras.

originals.name: Material Impact Cues
originals.idea: Each material kind picks its impact sound; flags for magical, holy and cursed items.
originals.keep: Material to impact; flags as data.

originals.name: Set Bonus Ladder
originals.idea: A set with a bonus at each piece threshold (2, 4, 6, 8).
